_README: Field labels for the certificate under Section 63, Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam 2023.
*** THESE LABELS ARE UNVERIFIED PARAPHRASES, NOT STATUTORY TEXT. ***
They were written from secondary descriptions of the Schedule so the emitter
could be built and tested. They are almost certainly wrong in wording, and may
be wrong in numbering and in which Part a field belongs to.
To finish this: open the bare Act, transcribe the Schedule verbatim into
'label' for every field, set 'verified' to true, and fill in 'source' and
'transcribed_by'. Until then every certificate this emits is stamped DRAFT and
says on its face that it must not be filed. That stamp is not a formality — a
certificate with invented statutory labels put before a court is worse than no
Owner: track E. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 13, open question 1.
